metric_definitions.agreement_percentage: percentage of LLM-classified rules where keyword and LLM IDs exactly agree, including rules both approaches leave unmapped.
metric_definitions.average_llm_confidence: arithmetic mean of valid LLM confidence values from 0 through 1; null when no valid scores are available.
metric_definitions.coverage_improvement_from_candidates: newly_mapped_rules divided by total_rules; this is a candidate coverage opportunity, not validated ATT&CK coverage.
metric_definitions.coverage_improvement_percentage: LLM classification rate minus keyword classification rate within the same LLM-evaluated cohort, expressed in percentage points.
metric_definitions.coverage_score: attack_mapped_rules divided by total_rules; a rule is mapped when it has direct or heuristic ATT&CK evidence.
metric_definitions.inflation_ratio: total_rules divided by unique_attack_techniques; 0 when no techniques are mapped.
metric_definitions.keyword_classification_rate: keyword_mapped_rules divided by total_rules, using direct references or existing heuristic mappings.
metric_definitions.llm_classification_rate: llm_mapped_rules divided by llm_classified_rules in the LLM-evaluated cohort; 0 when no rules were classified.
metric_definitions.mapped_rule_llm_validation.agreement_per: matches divided by total_tested_rules, expressed as a percentage.
metric_definitions.mapped_rule_llm_validation.average_confi: mean LLM confidence for mapped-rule validation rows with valid confidence scores.
metric_definitions.mapped_rule_llm_validation.disagreements: mapped-rule validation rows with a partial or mismatched LLM prediction.
metric_definitions.mapped_rule_llm_validation.matches: mapped-rule validation rows where the LLM predicted exactly the same ATT&CK ID set as the existing mapping.
metric_definitions.mapped_rule_llm_validation.mismatches: mapped-rule validation rows where the LLM predicted no overlap with the existing ATT&CK ID set.
metric_definitions.mapped_rule_llm_validation.partial_match: mapped-rule validation rows where the LLM predicted at least one existing ATT&CK ID and at least one difference.
metric_definitions.mapped_rule_llm_validation.total_tested_: already mapped rules submitted to the LLM for independent ATT&CK prediction.
metric_definitions.newly_mapped_rules: count of originally unmapped rules with one or more improved-heuristic or eligible LLM candidate mappings; candidates require validation.
metric_definitions.remaining_unmapped_rules_after_candidate: originally unmapped rules that have neither an improved-heuristic candidate nor an eligible LLM candidate.
